Package com.example.goboard.model

Class RuleEnforcer

java.lang.Object
com.example.goboard.model.RuleEnforcer
public class RuleEnforcer extends Object
Enforces Go game rules: ko, superko, and suicide. Responsibilities: - Track position history for superko detection - Check for ko (simple repetition) - Validate suicide moves - Manage board state snapshots
